findings.evidence: White player silhouette at .1/.2 seconds returns gray by .4. Persistent cyan location ring remains visually separate from the small orange impact. Large yellow-orange fireball at 1 second is clearly larger and disperses by 1.5.

Same connected elongated damage trail as accepted motion-9, visible at .4/.6 and curved behind player at 1.5 seconds. Older portions spread and fade toward the tail at 2/3 seconds; explosion cloud disperses. Fine grain and segmented far-tail sections remain cosmetic weaknesses.
Wakes remain attached to ship sterns throughout sampled camera movement, widening and fading behind carrier and escorts. Rounded repeating bands remain conspicuous.

Initial player position recenters by .6 seconds; player remains near center while background and vessels translate during turn and forward flight. Location ring consistently tracks aircraft in each sampled frame; no sampled jump or detached ring.

HUD, mission, minimap and buttons remain readable throughout. Escort behind Bomb at3 seconds does not hide label. Cyan ring helps distinguish player from carrier and other aircraft at .4/.6; it neither hides white damage flash nor nearby fireball. It is an obvious interface graphic, not additional realistic lighting.

nonblocking: Smoke remains grainy, with only modest lateral diffusion.
Wake foam repeats scalloped rounded bands.
Dense rippled ocean sometimes looks clothlike.
Cyan ring helps location but does not resolve actual silhouette overlap over roofs or other aircraft.
limits: All18 supplied frames and simulation timestamps/events reviewed. Acceptance is for sampled recognition/continuity, not full material realism, continuous playback smoothness or actual phone FPS. No source or identity keys read.
